# Exports

An export is a FILE of the mentions a filter selects, written in the background: `csv` (the spreadsheet columns) or `jsonl` (one whole Mention per line), up to 1,000,000 rows (`maxRows`), newest matched first. Use it when the user wants more mentions than a few list pages, or a file for a spreadsheet or a warehouse. The `filter` is GET /v1/mentions' own filters as an object, `viewId` and `alertId` included (`{}` is every mention). Exports are not billed. At most 2 run at once and 3,000,000 rows a day per workspace (`429 rate_limited`).

`POST /v1/exports` answers at once with the export `queued`. Poll `GET /v1/exports/{id}` every few seconds until `status` is `succeeded` (`stats.rows` grows meanwhile) or `failed` (`error` says why). Then hand the user `download.url`, a signed link that works without a key for an hour (read the export again for a fresh one), or fetch `GET /v1/exports/{id}/file` with the key. `truncated: true` means more matched than it holds: narrow the filter. Files are kept 7 days.

An export schedule (`/v1/export-schedules`) runs one every hour, day or week (UTC), each holding the mentions MATCHED since the previous run, and delivers it as an `export.ready` webhook event with a signed link, or writes it into the user's own S3-compatible bucket (S3, R2, GCS, B2). The bucket secret is write-only. Set schedules up only when the user asks, and never ask them to paste a secret into the chat: point them to Settings in the dashboard.

Base URL `https://api.mentio.dev`, `Authorization: Bearer $MENTIO_API_KEY` on every request, JSON in and out. The `mentio` CLI command for each endpoint is listed for when it is installed (rules/cli.md).

## Examples

```bash
# Every negative mention of the last 30 days as a CSV file
curl -sS -X POST "https://api.mentio.dev/v1/exports" -H "Authorization: Bearer $MENTIO_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"format": "csv", "filter": {"sentiments": ["negative"], "range": "30d"}}'

# Wait for it, then download
curl -sS "https://api.mentio.dev/v1/exports/exp_..." -H "Authorization: Bearer $MENTIO_API_KEY"
curl -sS "https://api.mentio.dev/v1/exports/exp_.../file" -H "Authorization: Bearer $MENTIO_API_KEY" -o mentions.csv
```

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | CLI | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/v1/exports` | `mentio exports:list` | List exports |
| `POST` | `/v1/exports` | `mentio exports:create` | Start an export |
| `GET` | `/v1/exports/{id}` | `mentio exports:get` | Get an export |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/exports/{id}` | `mentio exports:delete` | Delete an export |
| `GET` | `/v1/exports/{id}/file` | `mentio exports:file` | Download an export |
| `GET` | `/v1/export-schedules` | `mentio export-schedules:list` | List export schedules |
| `POST` | `/v1/export-schedules` | `mentio export-schedules:create` | Create an export schedule |
| `GET` | `/v1/export-schedules/{id}` | `mentio export-schedules:get` | Get an export schedule |
| `PATCH` | `/v1/export-schedules/{id}` | `mentio export-schedules:update` | Update an export schedule |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/export-schedules/{id}` | `mentio export-schedules:delete` | Delete an export schedule |
| `POST` | `/v1/export-schedules/{id}/test` | `mentio export-schedules:test` | Test an export schedule's bucket |

### GET /v1/exports

**List exports.** The workspace's exports, newest first, kept 90 days; their files are kept 7.

CLI: `mentio exports:list`

Query:

- `limit` (integer): Page size, 1 to 100.
- `cursor` (string): nextCursor from the previous page.

Returns: 200, a `LedgerList` (see Shapes below).

### POST /v1/exports

**Start an export.** Export the mentions a filter selects to a CSV or JSON Lines file, in the background.

- Up to 1,000,000 rows; GET /v1/mentions' filters, viewId included.
- Poll GET /v1/exports/{id}, then download.
- Not billed; 2 at once per workspace.

See [Exports](/guides/exports).

CLI: `mentio exports:create`

Body (JSON):

- `resource` (string): one of `mentions`. What is exported: mentions.
- `format` (string): one of `csv`, `jsonl`. csv: the spreadsheet columns of GET /v1/mentions/export.csv, text cut at 1,000 characters. jsonl: one whole Mention object per line (newline-delimited JSON), as GET /v1/mentions returns it.
- `filter` (object): Which mentions: every filter of GET /v1/mentions, in the same vocabulary (a list as an array or comma-separated), viewId and alertId included. {} is every mention the list shows.
  - `keywordId` (string): Deprecated: use keywordIds. Only matches of this keyword; combines with keywordIds as either.
  - `platform` (string): one of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`, `tiktok`, `instagram`, `facebook`, `podcasts`, `web`, `substack`, `producthunt`, `threads`, `mastodon`, `appstore`, `googleplay`, `trustpilot`, `googlemaps`, `rss`. Deprecated: use platforms. Only posts from this platform; combines with platforms as either.
  - `status` (string): one of `open`, `ignored`, `done`. Only mentions in this status. Omit for every status.
  - `relevant` (boolean): true: only mentions the classifier scored relevant; false: only the rest (unclassified included).
  - `sentiment` (string): one of `positive`, `neutral`, `negative`. Deprecated: use sentiments. Only this sentiment; combines with sentiments as either.
  - `intent` (string): Deprecated: use intents. Only mentions carrying this intent or topic tag, combined with intents as either (buy_intent, question, complaint, praise, comparison, churn_intent, bug_report, pricing, hiring, event, promotional, testimonial, industry_insight, launch, feedback).
  - `automated` (boolean): true: only mentions that read as machine-made (a bot account, a scheduled or templated post, AI-written text); false: only the rest, mentions judged before this existed included. Omitted: everything.
  - `organization` (boolean): true: only posts by companies, brands and organizations (a LinkedIn company page, a GitHub organization, a business account); false: only posts by people, mentions judged before this existed included. Omitted: everything.
  - `personId` (string): Only this person (an id from /v1/people), merged accounts included. Implies includeMuted.
  - `includeMuted` (boolean): true: include mentions by people you muted, hidden by default: muted for the workspace, or for the mention's own keyword group.
  - `includeHidden` (boolean): true: include mentions their keyword's display lists hide (a language or country it does not show), hidden by default.
  - `includeDuplicates` (boolean): true: list cross-posts (a mention whose duplicateOf is set) as mentions of their own. By default each is listed only in its original's duplicates.
  - `assigneeId` (string): Only mentions assigned to this workspace member (user id).
  - `snoozed` (boolean): true: only mentions currently snoozed. Otherwise snoozed mentions stay out until they wake.
  - `notAuthors` (array of string, nullable): Hide these authors: display names, handles or profile URLs. Repeatable, or one comma-separated value.
  - `excludeAuthors` (array of string, nullable): Deprecated: use notAuthors, the same filter. Both may be sent; every author named in either is hidden.
  - `minRelevance` (integer, nullable): Only mentions scored at least this; unclassified ones are excluded.
  - `minConfidence` (number, nullable): Only mentions whose classifier confidence is at least this, 0 to 1. Mentions without a confidence are excluded.
  - `minFollowers` (integer, nullable): Only authors with at least this many followers. Unknown reach never passes.
  - `maxFollowers` (integer, nullable): Only authors with at most this many followers. Unknown reach never passes.
  - `kind` (string): one of `post`, `comment`, `repository`. Only posts (post), only comments (comment) or only GitHub repository events (repository). Omitted: all.
  - `isReply` (boolean): true: only replies and comments (posts answering another post); false: only top-level posts. Omitted: both.
  - `alertId` (string): Apply an alert rule's filter (an id from GET /v1/alerts) on top of the other filters: the same mentions the rule would send, for a feed-shaped export or a preview. Unknown ids are a 404.
  - `viewId` (string): Apply a saved view's filter (an id from GET /v1/views) on top of the other filters, every condition ANDed: exactly what the view selects. Unknown ids are a 404.
  - `keywordKinds` (array of string): one of `brand`, `competitor`, `topic`. Only matches of keywords of any of these kinds: brand, competitor, topic. Repeatable, or comma-separated.
  - `notKeywordKinds` (array of string): one of `brand`, `competitor`, `topic`. Never matches of keywords of these kinds. Repeatable, or comma-separated.
  - `tags` (array of string, nullable): Only authors tagged with any of these (exact, case-sensitive), in the workspace's tags or those of the mention's own keyword group. Repeatable, or comma-separated.
  - `linkHosts` (array of string, nullable): Only posts linking to any of these hosts, the host itself or a subdomain of it (octolens.com also matches blog.octolens.com). Repeatable, or comma-separated.
  - `platforms` (array of string): one of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`, `tiktok`, `instagram`, `facebook`, `podcasts`, `web`, `substack`, `producthunt`, `threads`, `mastodon`, `appstore`, `googleplay`, `trustpilot`, `googlemaps`, `rss`. Only posts from any of these platforms.
  - `notPlatforms` (array of string): one of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`, `tiktok`, `instagram`, `facebook`, `podcasts`, `web`, `substack`, `producthunt`, `threads`, `mastodon`, `appstore`, `googleplay`, `trustpilot`, `googlemaps`, `rss`. Never posts from these platforms.
  - `keywordIds` (array of string, nullable): Only matches of any of these keywords.
  - `groupIds` (array of string, nullable): Only matches of keywords in any of these groups (grp_...). Repeatable, or comma-separated.
  - `notGroupIds` (array of string, nullable): Never matches of keywords in these groups.
  - `notKeywordIds` (array of string, nullable): Never matches of these keywords.
  - `sentiments` (array of string): one of `positive`, `neutral`, `negative`. Only these sentiments.
  - `notSentiments` (array of string): one of `positive`, `neutral`, `negative`. Never these sentiments. A mention the classifier has not scored yet still passes.
  - `emotions` (array of string): one of `joy`, `trust`, `anticipation`, `surprise`, `confusion`, `frustration`, `anger`, `fear`, `sadness`, `neutral`. Only mentions showing any of these emotions toward the keyword (joy, trust, anticipation, surprise, confusion, frustration, anger, fear, sadness, neutral). A mention whose emotion was not judged never passes.
  - `notEmotions` (array of string): one of `joy`, `trust`, `anticipation`, `surprise`, `confusion`, `frustration`, `anger`, `fear`, `sadness`, `neutral`. Never these emotions. A mention whose emotion was not judged still passes.
  - `intents` (array of string, nullable): Only mentions carrying any of these intent or topic tags.
  - `notIntents` (array of string, nullable): Never mentions carrying these intent or topic tags.
  - `notLinkHosts` (array of string, nullable): Never posts linking to these hosts, the host itself or a subdomain of it.
  - `subreddits` (array of string, nullable): Only Reddit posts from any of these subreddits: subreddits=SaaS,startups (names without the r/, any case). Every other post fails it. Repeatable, or comma-separated.
  - `notSubreddits` (array of string, nullable): Never Reddit posts from these subreddits; posts from other platforms still pass.
  - `notTags` (array of string, nullable): Never authors tagged with any of these, in the workspace's tags or those of the mention's own keyword group.
  - `labels` (array of string, nullable): Only mentions carrying any of these labels (exact, case-sensitive). Repeatable, or comma-separated.
  - `notLabels` (array of string, nullable): Never mentions carrying any of these labels. Repeatable, or comma-separated.
  - `languages` (array of string): Only posts in any of these languages (ISO 639-1: en, es, de). A post whose language is unknown never passes.
  - `notLanguages` (array of string): Never posts in these languages. A post whose language is unknown still passes.
  - `countries` (array of string): one of `us`, `ca`, `mx`, `br`, `ar`, `co`, `cl`, `pe`, `gb`, `ie`, `fr`, `de`, `es`, `pt`, `it`, `nl`, `be`, `ch`, `at`, `se`, `no`, `dk`, `fi`, `pl`, `cz`, `ro`, `gr`, `hu`, `ua`, `ru`, `lt`, `lv`, `ee`, `tr`, `il`, `ae`, `sa`, `eg`, `ng`, `ke`, `za`, `ma`, `in`, `pk`, `bd`, `lk`, `np`, `cn`, `hk`, `tw`, `jp`, `kr`, `sg`, `my`, `id`, `ph`, `vn`, `th`, `au`, `nz`. Only posts whose author is in any of these countries (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2: us, in, de), as the classifier read the author's profile and the post. A post whose country is unknown never passes.
  - `notCountries` (array of string): one of `us`, `ca`, `mx`, `br`, `ar`, `co`, `cl`, `pe`, `gb`, `ie`, `fr`, `de`, `es`, `pt`, `it`, `nl`, `be`, `ch`, `at`, `se`, `no`, `dk`, `fi`, `pl`, `cz`, `ro`, `gr`, `hu`, `ua`, `ru`, `lt`, `lv`, `ee`, `tr`, `il`, `ae`, `sa`, `eg`, `ng`, `ke`, `za`, `ma`, `in`, `pk`, `bd`, `lk`, `np`, `cn`, `hk`, `tw`, `jp`, `kr`, `sg`, `my`, `id`, `ph`, `vn`, `th`, `au`, `nz`. Never posts whose author is in these countries: notCountries=in. A post whose country is unknown still passes.
  - `ratings` (array of integer): Only app store reviews with any of these star ratings (1 to 5): ratings=1,2 is the unhappy ones. Every other post fails it.
  - `notRatings` (array of integer): Never reviews with these star ratings (1 to 5): notRatings=5 hides the five star reviews. Posts that are not reviews still pass.
  - `minLikes` (integer, nullable): Only posts with at least this many likes (upvotes, reactions), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.
  - `minReposts` (integer, nullable): Only posts with at least this many reposts (shares, retweets), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.
  - `minReplies` (integer, nullable): Only posts with at least this many replies (comments), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.
  - `minQuotes` (integer, nullable): Only posts with at least this many quotes, as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.
  - `minViews` (integer, nullable): Only posts with at least this many views (plays), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.
  - `minBookmarks` (integer, nullable): Only posts with at least this many bookmarks (saves), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.
  - `anyOf` (string): OR across groups of conditions, as URL-encoded JSON: a mention passes when one group holds, on top of every other filter. Each group holds view-filter conditions, no nesting. See [anyOf](/conventions#or-across-groups-anyof).
  - `q` (string): Substring search in the post text or the author's name.
  - `range` (string): one of `7d`, `30d`, `90d`, `365d`. A preset window ending now: 7d is today and the six days before, in `timezone`, as in the analytics reports. Ignored when from or to is given. Omit range, from and to for no window.
  - `from` (string): Start, inclusive: a day (YYYY-MM-DD, from its first moment in `timezone`) or an instant (ISO 8601 with its offset, or epoch ms).
  - `to` (string): End, inclusive: a day (YYYY-MM-DD, to its last moment in `timezone`) or an instant (ISO 8601 with its offset, or epoch ms).
  - `timezone` (string): IANA zone that days in range, from and to are cut in (Europe/Madrid). Default UTC.
  - `since` (string): Deprecated: use from. Only posts published at or after this instant (ISO 8601, or epoch ms).
  - `until` (string): Deprecated: use to. Only posts published at or before this instant (ISO 8601, or epoch ms).
- `maxRows` (integer): Stop after this many rows, newest matched first. At most 1,000,000, the default.

Returns: 201, a `Export` (see Shapes below).

### GET /v1/exports/{id}

**Get an export.** Its status and progress. Once succeeded, `download.url` is a signed link to the file valid for an hour; read again for a fresh one.

CLI: `mentio exports:get`

Path:

- `id` (string, required): Export id (exp_...).

Returns: 200, a `Export` (see Shapes below).

### DELETE /v1/exports/{id}

**Delete an export.** Deletes the file and the export: its signed links stop working at once. A running export stops.

CLI: `mentio exports:delete`

Path:

- `id` (string, required): Export id (exp_...).

Returns: 204, no body.

### GET /v1/exports/{id}/file

**Download an export.** The file of a succeeded export, streamed: CSV (text/csv) or JSON Lines (application/x-ndjson).

CLI: `mentio exports:file`

Path:

- `id` (string, required): Export id (exp_...).

Returns: 200, CSV text.

### GET /v1/export-schedules

**List export schedules.** The workspace's recurring exports, oldest first.

CLI: `mentio export-schedules:list`

Returns: 200, a `InvoiceList` (see Shapes below).

### POST /v1/export-schedules

**Create an export schedule.** Export the mentions matched since the last run, hourly, daily or weekly (UTC).

- link: an export.ready webhook event with a signed download link.
- s3: the file written into your own S3-compatible bucket (S3, R2, GCS, B2, MinIO).
- At most 10 per workspace.

See [Exports](/guides/exports).

CLI: `mentio export-schedules:create`

Body (JSON):

- `name` (string, required): Unique per workspace, case-insensitive.
- `enabled` (boolean): false saves it without running it.
- `format` (string): one of `csv`, `jsonl`. csv: the spreadsheet columns of GET /v1/mentions/export.csv, text cut at 1,000 characters. jsonl: one whole Mention object per line (newline-delimited JSON), as GET /v1/mentions returns it.

  - `notCountries` (array of string): one of `us`, `ca`, `mx`, `br`, `ar`, `co`, `cl`, `pe`, `gb`, `ie`, `fr`, `de`, `es`, `pt`, `it`, `nl`, `be`, `ch`, `at`, `se`, `no`, `dk`, `fi`, `pl`, `cz`, `ro`, `gr`, `hu`, `ua`, `ru`, `lt`, `lv`, `ee`, `tr`, `il`, `ae`, `sa`, `eg`, `ng`, `ke`, `za`, `ma`, `in`, `pk`, `bd`, `lk`, `np`, `cn`, `hk`, `tw`, `jp`, `kr`, `sg`, `my`, `id`, `ph`, `vn`, `th`, `au`, `nz`. Never posts whose author is in these countries: notCountries=in. A post whose country is unknown still passes.
  - `ratings` (array of integer): Only app store reviews with any of these star ratings (1 to 5): ratings=1,2 is the unhappy ones. Every other post fails it.
  - `notRatings` (array of integer): Never reviews with these star ratings (1 to 5): notRatings=5 hides the five star reviews. Posts that are not reviews still pass.
  - `minLikes` (integer, nullable): Only posts with at least this many likes (upvotes, reactions), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.
  - `minReposts` (integer, nullable): Only posts with at least this many reposts (shares, retweets), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.
  - `minReplies` (integer, nullable): Only posts with at least this many replies (comments), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.
  - `minQuotes` (integer, nullable): Only posts with at least this many quotes, as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.
  - `minViews` (integer, nullable): Only posts with at least this many views (plays), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.
  - `minBookmarks` (integer, nullable): Only posts with at least this many bookmarks (saves), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.
  - `anyOf` (string): OR across groups of conditions, as URL-encoded JSON: a mention passes when one group holds, on top of every other filter. Each group holds view-filter conditions, no nesting. See [anyOf](/conventions#or-across-groups-anyof).
  - `q` (string): Substring search in the post text or the author's name.
- `cadence` (string, required): one of `hourly`, `daily`, `weekly`. hourly: at five past each UTC hour, the hour before. daily: at hour (UTC), the 24 hours before. weekly: on weekday at hour (UTC), the week before.
- `hour` (integer): UTC hour daily and weekly runs start, 0 to 23 (default 6). Ignored for hourly.
- `weekday` (string): one of `monday`, `tuesday`, `wednesday`, `thursday`, `friday`, `saturday`, `sunday`. Required for weekly; refused otherwise.
- `destination` (one of object | object, required): Where each run goes. link: an export.ready event to your webhook channels, with a signed download link. s3: the file written into your own S3-compatible bucket (S3, R2, GCS, B2, MinIO), then the same event.

Returns: 201, a `ExportSchedule` (see Shapes below).

### GET /v1/export-schedules/{id}

**Get an export schedule.**

CLI: `mentio export-schedules:get`

Path:

- `id` (string, required): Export schedule id (exs_...).

Returns: 200, a `ExportSchedule` (see Shapes below).

### PATCH /v1/export-schedules/{id}

**Update an export schedule.** Omitted fields are untouched. A new timing keeps the delta: the next run starts where the last one ended. Enabled again, it starts from the next run.

CLI: `mentio export-schedules:update`

Path:

- `id` (string, required): Export schedule id (exs_...).

Body (JSON):

- `name` (string): Schedule name, unique in the workspace.
- `enabled` (boolean): false stops it; true starts it again from the next run.
- `format` (string): one of `csv`, `jsonl`. csv: the spreadsheet columns of GET /v1/mentions/export.csv, text cut at 1,000 characters. jsonl: one whole Mention object per line (newline-delimited JSON), as GET /v1/mentions returns it.
- `filter` (object): Replaces the whole filter.
  - `keywordId` (string): Deprecated: use keywordIds. Only matches of this keyword; combines with keywordIds as either.
  - `platform` (string): one of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`, `tiktok`, `instagram`, `facebook`, `podcasts`, `web`, `substack`, `producthunt`, `threads`, `mastodon`, `appstore`, `googleplay`, `trustpilot`, `googlemaps`, `rss`. Deprecated: use platforms. Only posts from this platform; combines with platforms as either.
  - `status` (string): one of `open`, `ignored`, `done`. Only mentions in this status. Omit for every status.
  - `relevant` (boolean): true: only mentions the classifier scored relevant; false: only the rest (unclassified included).
  - `sentiment` (string): one of `positive`, `neutral`, `negative`. Deprecated: use sentiments. Only this sentiment; combines with sentiments as either.
  - `intent` (string): Deprecated: use intents. Only mentions carrying this intent or topic tag, combined with intents as either (buy_intent, question, complaint, praise, comparison, churn_intent, bug_report, pricing, hiring, event, promotional, testimonial, industry_insight, launch, feedback).
  - `automated` (boolean): true: only mentions that read as machine-made (a bot account, a scheduled or templated post, AI-written text); false: only the rest, mentions judged before this existed included. Omitted: everything.
  - `organization` (boolean): true: only posts by companies, brands and organizations (a LinkedIn company page, a GitHub organization, a business account); false: only posts by people, mentions judged before this existed included. Omitted: everything.
  - `personId` (string): Only this person (an id from /v1/people), merged accounts included. Implies includeMuted.
  - `includeMuted` (boolean): true: include mentions by people you muted, hidden by default: muted for the workspace, or for the mention's own keyword group.
  - `includeHidden` (boolean): true: include mentions their keyword's display lists hide (a language or country it does not show), hidden by default.
  - `includeDuplicates` (boolean): true: list cross-posts (a mention whose duplicateOf is set) as mentions of their own. By default each is listed only in its original's duplicates.
  - `assigneeId` (string): Only mentions assigned to this workspace member (user id).
  - `snoozed` (boolean): true: only mentions currently snoozed. Otherwise snoozed mentions stay out until they wake.
  - `notAuthors` (array of string, nullable): Hide these authors: display names, handles or profile URLs. Repeatable, or one comma-separated value.
  - `excludeAuthors` (array of string, nullable): Deprecated: use notAuthors, the same filter. Both may be sent; every author named in either is hidden.
  - `minRelevance` (integer, nullable): Only mentions scored at least this; unclassified ones are excluded.
  - `minConfidence` (number, nullable): Only mentions whose classifier confidence is at least this, 0 to 1. Mentions without a confidence are excluded.
  - `minFollowers` (integer, nullable): Only authors with at least this many followers. Unknown reach never passes.
  - `maxFollowers` (integer, nullable): Only authors with at most this many followers. Unknown reach never passes.
  - `kind` (string): one of `post`, `comment`, `repository`. Only posts (post), only comments (comment) or only GitHub repository events (repository). Omitted: all.
  - `isReply` (boolean): true: only replies and comments (posts answering another post); false: only top-level posts. Omitted: both.
  - `alertId` (string): Apply an alert rule's filter (an id from GET /v1/alerts) on top of the other filters: the same mentions the rule would send, for a feed-shaped export or a preview. Unknown ids are a 404.
  - `viewId` (string): Apply a saved view's filter (an id from GET /v1/views) on top of the other filters, every condition ANDed: exactly what the view selects. Unknown ids are a 404.
  - `keywordKinds` (array of string): one of `brand`, `competitor`, `topic`. Only matches of keywords of any of these kinds: brand, competitor, topic. Repeatable, or comma-separated.
  - `notKeywordKinds` (array of string): one of `brand`, `competitor`, `topic`. Never matches of keywords of these kinds. Repeatable, or comma-separated.
  - `tags` (array of string, nullable): Only authors tagged with any of these (exact, case-sensitive), in the workspace's tags or those of the mention's own keyword group. Repeatable, or comma-separated.
  - `linkHosts` (array of string, nullable): Only posts linking to any of these hosts, the host itself or a subdomain of it (octolens.com also matches blog.octolens.com). Repeatable, or comma-separated.

Only posts from any of these platforms.
  - `notPlatforms` (array of string): one of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`, `tiktok`, `instagram`, `facebook`, `podcasts`, `web`, `substack`, `producthunt`, `threads`, `mastodon`, `appstore`, `googleplay`, `trustpilot`, `googlemaps`, `rss`. Returns: 200, a `ExportSchedule` (see Shapes below).

### DELETE /v1/export-schedules/{id}

**Delete an export schedule.** It stops; the exports it already made stay until they age out.

CLI: `mentio export-schedules:delete`

Path:

- `id` (string, required): Export schedule id (exs_...).

Returns: 204, no body.

### POST /v1/export-schedules/{id}/test

**Test an export schedule's bucket.** Writes a tiny text file to the bucket with the stored credentials.

A mistake shows now rather than at the first run; a link destination has nothing to test.

CLI: `mentio export-schedules:test`

Path:

- `id` (string, required): Export schedule id (exs_...).

Returns: 200, an object:

- `ok` (boolean, required): true: a small test object was written to the bucket.
- `key` (string, required, nullable): The test object written (a tiny text file you may delete); null for a link destination.
- `error` (string, required, nullable): What the bucket answered when it refused, or why nothing was tried.

  - `minLikes` (integer, nullable): Only posts with at least this many likes (upvotes, reactions), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.
  - `minReposts` (integer, nullable): Only posts with at least this many reposts (shares, retweets), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.
  - `minReplies` (integer, nullable): Only posts with at least this many replies (comments), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.
  - `minQuotes` (integer, nullable): Only posts with at least this many quotes, as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.
  - `minViews` (integer, nullable): Only posts with at least this many views (plays), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.
  - `minBookmarks` (integer, nullable): Only posts with at least this many bookmarks (saves), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.
  - `anyOf` (string): OR across groups of conditions, as URL-encoded JSON: a mention passes when one group holds, on top of every other filter. Each group holds view-filter conditions, no nesting. See [anyOf](/conventions#or-across-groups-anyof).
  - `q` (string): Substring search in the post text or the author's name.
  - `range` (string): one of `7d`, `30d`, `90d`, `365d`. A preset window ending now: 7d is today and the six days before, in `timezone`, as in the analytics reports. Ignored when from or to is given. Omit range, from and to for no window.
  - `from` (string): Start, inclusive: a day (YYYY-MM-DD, from its first moment in `timezone`) or an instant (ISO 8601 with its offset, or epoch ms).
  - `to` (string): End, inclusive: a day (YYYY-MM-DD, to its last moment in `timezone`) or an instant (ISO 8601 with its offset, or epoch ms).
  - `timezone` (string): IANA zone that days in range, from and to are cut in (Europe/Madrid). Default UTC.
  - `since` (string): Deprecated: use from. Only posts published at or after this instant (ISO 8601, or epoch ms).
  - `until` (string): Deprecated: use to. Only posts published at or before this instant (ISO 8601, or epoch ms).
- `scheduleId` (string, required, nullable): The schedule that ran it (exs_...), or null for one created by hand.
- `window` (object, required, nullable): A scheduled run: the stretch of match time it covers. null for a one-off export, which reads the filter as given.
  - `from` (string, required): Start, inclusive (match time).
  - `to` (string, required): End, exclusive (match time).
- `maxRows` (integer, required): The most rows it writes.
- `stats` (object, required): Progress, and the size of the file once it succeeded.
  - `rows` (integer, required): Rows written so far.
  - `bytes` (integer, required): Bytes written so far.
- `truncated` (boolean, required): true when more mentions matched than it holds (maxRows or the 2 GiB file bound): narrow the filter and export again.
- `error` (object, required, nullable): Why it failed; null otherwise.
  - `code` (string, required): timed_out, invalid_filter or internal_error.
  - `message` (string, required): What went wrong, in a sentence.
- `download` (object, required, nullable): Once it succeeded: a signed download link, valid for an hour. null before, after the file expired, or when this deployment cannot sign links.
  - `url` (string, required): Signed link to the file; works without a key until expiresAt. GET /v1/exports/{id}/file downloads it with a key.
  - `expiresAt` (string, required): When this link stops working; read the export again for a fresh one.
- `fileExpiresAt` (string, required, nullable): When the file is deleted: 7 days after it succeeded.
- `delivery` (object, required, nullable): A scheduled run: where the file goes and how that went. null for a one-off export.
  - `kind` (string, required): one of `link`, `s3`. link: an export.ready webhook event. s3: the file written into your bucket.
  - `status` (string, required): one of `pending`, `delivered`, `failed`. pending, delivered or failed.
  - `key` (string, required, nullable): s3: the object key written.
  - `error` (string, required, nullable): Why the last attempt failed.
  - `deliveredAt` (string, required, nullable): When it was delivered.
- `createdAt` (string, required): ISO 8601 timestamp, UTC.
- `startedAt` (string, required, nullable): When the first rows were written.
- `completedAt` (string, required, nullable): When it succeeded or failed.

### LedgerList

- `data` (array of object, required): Ledger entries, newest first.
  - `id` (string, required): Ledger entry id (led_...).
  - `kind` (string, required): one of `signup_credit`, `topup`, `refund`, `debit_keyword_days`, `debit_mentions`, `debit_comments`, `debit_searches`, `adjustment`. signup_credit, topup, refund, debit_keyword_days, debit_mentions, debit_comments, debit_searches (on-demand search results) or adjustment.
  - `amountCents` (integer, required): Integer USD cents; credits positive, debits negative.
  - `day` (string, required, nullable): Debit rows: the last UTC day the row settled (YYYY-MM-DD).
  - `units` (integer, required, nullable): Debit rows: cumulative units (mentions or keyword-days) settled up to this row.
  - `note` (string, required, nullable): Free text on credits and adjustments.
  - `polarOrderId` (string, required, nullable): Top-ups and refunds: the Polar order.
  - `createdAt` (string, required): ISO 8601 timestamp, UTC.
- `nextCursor` (string, required, nullable): Pass it back as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last.

### ExportSchedule

- `id` (string, required): Schedule id (exs_...).
- `name` (string, required): Schedule name, unique in the workspace.
- `enabled` (boolean, required): false: kept, never run.
- `format` (string, required): one of `csv`, `jsonl`. csv: the spreadsheet columns of GET /v1/mentions/export.csv, text cut at 1,000 characters. jsonl: one whole Mention object per line (newline-delimited JSON), as GET /v1/mentions returns it.
- `filter` (object, required): Which mentions: every filter of GET /v1/mentions except the window (range, from, to): each run exports the mentions matched since the previous run.
  - `keywordId` (string): Deprecated: use keywordIds. Only matches of this keyword; combines with keywordIds as either.
  - `platform` (string): one of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`, `tiktok`, `instagram`, `facebook`, `podcasts`, `web`, `substack`, `producthunt`, `threads`, `mastodon`, `appstore`, `googleplay`, `trustpilot`, `googlemaps`, `rss`. Deprecated: use platforms. Only posts from this platform; combines with platforms as either.
  - `status` (string): one of `open`, `ignored`, `done`. Only mentions in this status. Omit for every status.
  - `relevant` (boolean): true: only mentions the classifier scored relevant; false: only the rest (unclassified included).
  - `sentiment` (string): one of `positive`, `neutral`, `negative`. Deprecated: use sentiments. Only this sentiment; combines with sentiments as either.
  - `intent` (string): Deprecated: use intents. Only mentions carrying this intent or topic tag, combined with intents as either (buy_intent, question, complaint, praise, comparison, churn_intent, bug_report, pricing, hiring, event, promotional, testimonial, industry_insight, launch, feedback).
  - `automated` (boolean): true: only mentions that read as machine-made (a bot account, a scheduled or templated post, AI-written text); false: only the rest, mentions judged before this existed included. Omitted: everything.
  - `organization` (boolean): true: only posts by companies, brands and organizations (a LinkedIn company page, a GitHub organization, a business account); false: only posts by people, mentions judged before this existed included. Omitted: everything.
  - `personId` (string): Only this person (an id from /v1/people), merged accounts included. Implies includeMuted.
  - `includeMuted` (boolean): true: include mentions by people you muted, hidden by default: muted for the workspace, or for the mention's own keyword group.
  - `includeHidden` (boolean): true: include mentions their keyword's display lists hide (a language or country it does not show), hidden by default.
  - `includeDuplicates` (boolean): true: list cross-posts (a mention whose duplicateOf is set) as mentions of their own. By default each is listed only in its original's duplicates.
  - `assigneeId` (string): Only mentions assigned to this workspace member (user id).
  - `snoozed` (boolean): true: only mentions currently snoozed. Otherwise snoozed mentions stay out until they wake.
  - `notAuthors` (array of string, nullable): Hide these authors: display names, handles or profile URLs. Repeatable, or one comma-separated value.
  - `excludeAuthors` (array of string, nullable): Deprecated: use notAuthors, the same filter. Both may be sent; every author named in either is hidden.
  - `minRelevance` (integer, nullable): Only mentions scored at least this; unclassified ones are excluded.
  - `minConfidence` (number, nullable): Only mentions whose classifier confidence is at least this, 0 to 1. Mentions without a confidence are excluded.
  - `minFollowers` (integer, nullable): Only authors with at least this many followers. Unknown reach never passes.
  - `maxFollowers` (integer, nullable): Only authors with at most this many followers. Unknown reach never passes.
  - `kind` (string): one of `post`, `comment`, `repository`. Only posts (post), only comments (comment) or only GitHub repository events (repository). Omitted: all.
  - `isReply` (boolean): true: only replies and comments (posts answering another post); false: only top-level posts. Omitted: both.
  - `alertId` (string): Apply an alert rule's filter (an id from GET /v1/alerts) on top of the other filters: the same mentions the rule would send, for a feed-shaped export or a preview. Unknown ids are a 404.
  - `viewId` (string): Apply a saved view's filter (an id from GET /v1/views) on top of the other filters, every condition ANDed: exactly what the view selects. Unknown ids are a 404.
  - `keywordKinds` (array of string): one of `brand`, `competitor`, `topic`. Only matches of keywords of any of these kinds: brand, competitor, topic. Repeatable, or comma-separated.
  - `notKeywordKinds` (array of string): one of `brand`, `competitor`, `topic`. Never matches of keywords of these kinds. Repeatable, or comma-separated.
  - `tags` (array of string, nullable): Only authors tagged with any of these (exact, case-sensitive), in the workspace's tags or those of the mention's own keyword group. Repeatable, or comma-separated.
  - `linkHosts` (array of string, nullable): Only posts linking to any of these hosts, the host itself or a subdomain of it (octolens.com also matches blog.octolens.com). Repeatable, or comma-separated.
  - `platforms` (array of string): one of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`, `tiktok`, `instagram`, `facebook`, `podcasts`, `web`, `substack`, `producthunt`, `threads`, `mastodon`, `appstore`, `googleplay`, `trustpilot`, `googlemaps`, `rss`. Only posts from any of these platforms.
  - `notPlatforms` (array of string): one of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`, `tiktok`, `instagram`, `facebook`, `podcasts`, `web`, `substack`, `producthunt`, `threads`, `mastodon`, `appstore`, `googleplay`, `trustpilot`, `googlemaps`, `rss`. Never posts from these platforms.
  - `keywordIds` (array of string, nullable): Only matches of any of these keywords.
  - `groupIds` (array of string, nullable): Only matches of keywords in any of these groups (grp_...). Repeatable, or comma-separated.
  - `notGroupIds` (array of string, nullable): Never matches of keywords in these groups.
  - `notKeywordIds` (array of string, nullable): Never matches of these keywords.
  - `sentiments` (array of string): one of `positive`, `neutral`, `negative`. Only these sentiments.
  - `notSentiments` (array of string): one of `positive`, `neutral`, `negative`. Never these sentiments. A mention the classifier has not scored yet still passes.
  - `emotions` (array of string): one of `joy`, `trust`, `anticipation`, `surprise`, `confusion`, `frustration`, `anger`, `fear`, `sadness`, `neutral`. Only mentions showing any of these emotions toward the keyword (joy, trust, anticipation, surprise, confusion, frustration, anger, fear, sadness, neutral). A mention whose emotion was not judged never passes.
  - `notEmotions` (array of string): one of `joy`, `trust`, `anticipation`, `surprise`, `confusion`, `frustration`, `anger`, `fear`, `sadness`, `neutral`. Never these emotions. A mention whose emotion was not judged still passes.
  - `intents` (array of string, nullable): Only mentions carrying any of these intent or topic tags.
  - `notIntents` (array of string, nullable): Never mentions carrying these intent or topic tags.
  - `notLinkHosts` (array of string, nullable): Never posts linking to these hosts, the host itself or a subdomain of it.
  - `subreddits` (array of string, nullable): Only Reddit posts from any of these subreddits: subreddits=SaaS,startups (names without the r/, any case). Every other post fails it. Repeatable, or comma-separated.
  - `notSubreddits` (array of string, nullable): Never Reddit posts from these subreddits; posts from other platforms still pass.
  - `notTags` (array of string, nullable): Never authors tagged with any of these, in the workspace's tags or those of the mention's own keyword group.
  - `labels` (array of string, nullable): Only mentions carrying any of these labels (exact, case-sensitive). Repeatable, or comma-separated.
  - `notLabels` (array of string, nullable): Never mentions carrying any of these labels. Repeatable, or comma-separated.
  - `languages` (array of string): Only posts in any of these languages (ISO 639-1: en, es, de). A post whose language is unknown never passes.
  - `notLanguages` (array of string): Never posts in these languages. A post whose language is unknown still passes.
  - `countries` (array of string): one of `us`, `ca`, `mx`, `br`, `ar`, `co`, `cl`, `pe`, `gb`, `ie`, `fr`, `de`, `es`, `pt`, `it`, `nl`, `be`, `ch`, `at`, `se`, `no`, `dk`, `fi`, `pl`, `cz`, `ro`, `gr`, `hu`, `ua`, `ru`, `lt`, `lv`, `ee`, `tr`, `il`, `ae`, `sa`, `eg`, `ng`, `ke`, `za`, `ma`, `in`, `pk`, `bd`, `lk`, `np`, `cn`, `hk`, `tw`, `jp`, `kr`, `sg`, `my`, `id`, `ph`, `vn`, `th`, `au`, `nz`. Only posts whose author is in any of these countries (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2: us, in, de), as the classifier read the author's profile and the post. A post whose country is unknown never passes.
  - `notCountries` (array of string): one of `us`, `ca`, `mx`, `br`, `ar`, `co`, `cl`, `pe`, `gb`, `ie`, `fr`, `de`, `es`, `pt`, `it`, `nl`, `be`, `ch`, `at`, `se`, `no`, `dk`, `fi`, `pl`, `cz`, `ro`, `gr`, `hu`, `ua`, `ru`, `lt`, `lv`, `ee`, `tr`, `il`, `ae`, `sa`, `eg`, `ng`, `ke`, `za`, `ma`, `in`, `pk`, `bd`, `lk`, `np`, `cn`, `hk`, `tw`, `jp`, `kr`, `sg`, `my`, `id`, `ph`, `vn`, `th`, `au`, `nz`. Never posts whose author is in these countries: notCountries=in. A post whose country is unknown still passes.
  - `ratings` (array of integer): Only app store reviews with any of these star ratings (1 to 5): ratings=1,2 is the unhappy ones. Every other post fails it.
  - `notRatings` (array of integer): Never reviews with these star ratings (1 to 5): notRatings=5 hides the five star reviews. Posts that are not reviews still pass.
  - `minLikes` (integer, nullable): Only posts with at least this many likes (upvotes, reactions), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.
  - `minReposts` (integer, nullable): Only posts with at least this many reposts (shares, retweets), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.
  - `minReplies` (integer, nullable): Only posts with at least this many replies (comments), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.
  - `minQuotes` (integer, nullable): Only posts with at least this many quotes, as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.
  - `minViews` (integer, nullable): Only posts with at least this many views (plays), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.
  - `minBookmarks` (integer, nullable): Only posts with at least this many bookmarks (saves), as the platform reported them when the post was found. A post without that count never passes.
  - `anyOf` (string): OR across groups of conditions, as URL-encoded JSON: a mention passes when one group holds, on top of every other filter. Each group holds view-filter conditions, no nesting. See [anyOf](/conventions#or-across-groups-anyof).
  - `q` (string): Substring search in the post text or the author's name.
- `cadence` (string, required): one of `hourly`, `daily`, `weekly`. hourly: at five past each UTC hour, the hour before. daily: at hour (UTC), the 24 hours before. weekly: on weekday at hour (UTC), the week before.
- `hour` (integer, required): UTC hour daily and weekly runs start.
- `weekday` (string, required, nullable): one of `monday`, `tuesday`, `wednesday`, `thursday`, `friday`, `saturday`, `sunday`. Weekly runs: the day; null otherwise.
- `destination` (one of object | object, required): Where each run goes.
- `nextRunAt` (string, required, nullable): When it runs next; null while disabled.
- `lastRunAt` (string, required, nullable): When it last ran.
- `lastExportId` (string, required, nullable): The export its last run made (exp_...).
- `lastError` (string, required, nullable): Why the last run or delivery failed; null after one that worked.
- `createdAt` (string, required): ISO 8601 timestamp, UTC.
- `updatedAt` (string, required): ISO 8601 timestamp, UTC.

### InvoiceList

- `data` (array of object, required): Paid orders, newest first; empty before the first top-up.
  - `id` (string, required): The Polar order id; what GET /v1/billing/invoices/{id}/url takes.
  - `createdAt` (string, required): When the order was placed (ISO 8601).
  - `status` (string, required): The order status as Polar reports it (paid, refunded, ...).
  - `paid` (boolean, required): Whether the order was paid.
  - `totalAmount` (integer, required): What was charged, in minor units of `currency`, tax included.
  - `currency` (string, required): ISO 4217 currency of the order (usd).
  - `billingReason` (string, required, nullable): Why the order exists, as Polar reports it (purchase, subscription_cycle, ...); null when it does not say.
